meta.source: Built from the existing OneLoaf pages (public site index.html and Admin_Panel.dc.html): palette, Cormorant Garamond + DM Sans, radii, shadows, pills, 44px targets. Adjusted for WCAG 2.1 AA and a dark theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (cream / espresso). Body text: ink 15.2:1 light, 16.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies. ink-muted on it: 5.85:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wheat: table headers, section bands, input wells, skeletons. Never put primary text on it (4.28:1): use primary-strong.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, menus, toasts (above surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, helper text, inactive nav. ≥4.9:1 on every surface incl. primary-tint.

tokens.name: ink-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-strong fills (4.98:1 light, 7.15:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active tab indicator, focus of brand actions. Text use only on bg, surface, surface-raised (≥4.66:1).

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary; primary-coloured text on wheat and on primary-tint (5.46:1).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected chip, pending-action card background. Text on it: ink or primary-strong.

tokens.name: brand-terra
tokens.usage: Brand terracotta from the original OneLoaf pages: logo heart, display headings ≥24px, icons, decorative blocks. NOT for body text or white-on-terra buttons (3.9:1 fails AA).

tokens.name: brand-blush
tokens.usage: Blush accent: logo on espresso, illustrations. Decorative only on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-espresso
tokens.usage: Deep espresso: admin sidebar, footer, dark ground. blush on it 11.7:1.

tokens.name: espresso-ink
tokens.usage: Text and logo on the always-dark espresso sidebar (16.2:1).

tokens.name: espresso-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive items on the espresso sidebar (9.3:1).

tokens.name: espresso-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background on the espresso sidebar.

tokens.name: espresso-selected
tokens.usage: Selected item background on the espresso sidebar.

tokens.name: espresso-accent
tokens.usage: Selected item text on espresso-selected (6.8:1).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons, chips: ≥3:1 against bg and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px outline + 2px offset) on every interactive element; blue so it differs from brand terra by hue and lightness. ≥6.3:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done stages, complete cost, positive deltas. Text on bg/surface and on success-tint.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Running stages, incomplete cost, missing prices, feeding due soon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, overdue feeding, failed bakes.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and invalid-field messages.

tokens.name: ink-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid danger fill (destructive button): 5.93:1 light, 7.88:1 dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Planned status, AI disclosure, neutral information.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing and empty-state hero only. 2.5rem below 600px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles. Smallest size allowed in brand-terra (24px, 3:1 rule).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: List item titles, top bar title on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mix flour and water, rest 45 minutes.
styles.usage: Default text. Never below 1rem for paragraphs.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary info, helper text, table cells on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines, form labels, table headers (from the original admin style, raised from 11px to 12px).

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Calculator figures and stat tiles; always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; page side padding on phones; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet/desktop; grid gutter on tablet+.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop; between major sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero spacing, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, table action buttons, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, segmented controls, nav items (10px, as in the admin panel).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels (16px, as in the original cards).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets (20px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, switches (the original pill buttons).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tables.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, bottom navigation.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

size.note: Interactive sizes. rem so they grow with the user's display scale.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of every interactive element (44px at 100%).

tokens.name: target-comfortable
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones (Start/Complete stage, Confirm plan).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, badges and dense tables.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons and lists.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation icons (bottom bar, rail, sidebar).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main content column on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max-ultra
tokens.usage: Max width on 4K / ultrawide (≥160em): the content splits into four panes (list · recipe · calculator · plan) instead of stretching one column.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max line length for chat and long text (about 70 characters).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded navigation sidebar (desktop ≥1024px).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Navigation rail (tablet 600–1023px, phone landscape).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top app bar.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar (plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).

breakpoint.note: Window size classes, used in media queries as em (zoom-safe). CSS variables cannot be used inside @media, so bundle.css repeats these values.

tokens.name: bp-watch
tokens.usage: Below 280px: smartwatch / cover screens; single column, icon-only nav in a menu.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: 600px: tablet portrait, unfolded foldables, phone landscape; nav rail, 8-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: 1024px: tablet landscape and desktop; sidebar, 12-column grid, list-detail layouts.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: 1440px: large desktop; wider gutters, side panels open by default.

tokens.name: bp-ultra
tokens.usage: 2560px: 4K and ultrawide; content-max-ultra, four panes.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Top bar, bottom navigation, rail, sidebar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, dialogs, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
